subject: AWS co-sell: Solstice Health kickoff — stakeholder map, procurement windows, and demo cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot.barnes@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: AWS co-sell: Solstice Health kickoff — stakeholder map, procurement windows, and demo cadence

Hi Elliot — great to meet briefly on the call last week. As discussed with the AWS field team, we'd like to kick off a short co-sell intake and align on procurement timelines so we can land a joint account plan. Proposed agenda for the intro: 1) quick intros & roles, 2) primary success metrics & security constraints, 3) procurement timeline and preferred contracting route (preferred PO/Net terms or AWS Marketplace), 4) schedule for technical demo and follow-up.

Could you confirm the right procurement contact and 2–3 windows next week for a 30-minute intro? We'll follow that with a 60-minute technical deep dive (separate invite) with our solutions engineer.

I'll attach a blank mutual action plan and our co-sell intake form so procurement has the fields up front. If you have an internal RFP or compliance checklist, please share it and we will prioritize what matters for your security team.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Irene Choi
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: RDW_AWS_CoSell_Intake_Form.pdf (form), Solstice_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (blank template)

From: Elliot Barnes <elliot.barnes@solsticehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nora Lin <nora.lin@solsticehealth.com>, procurement@solsticehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Solstice Health kickoff — stakeholder map, procurement windows, and demo cadence

Hi Irene — thanks for the note and the materials. Nora is our procurement lead (cc'd) and will own contracting. A couple quick items from our side:

- Availability for an intro: Tue 10/06 10:00–10:30 PT, Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT, or Thu 10/08 11:00–11:30 PT. Tue or Wed would work best.
- Security: we need to validate SOC 2 Type II and a brief note on data residency (US-only). I will get our security team to flag any hard blockers but likely we just need cert copies and a short call.
- Procurement preference: we prefer AWS Marketplace (PR/charge-through) but are open to a standard PO if Marketplace listing isn't available soon.

I'll attach our internal procurement intake (RFP snippet) — highlights are licensing term, liability caps, and SLAs. Nora — looping you to pick a slot and confirm whether Marketplace is acceptable.

Elliot
Head of Product, Solstice Health
elliot.barnes@solsticehealth.com

--
Attachment stubs: Solstice_RFP_Procurement_Snippet.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Solstice Health AWS co-sell — prep checklist (do not forward)

Team — quick internal note after Elliot's reply. I captured primary asks and next steps below. Please treat this as internal prep before intro: 

- Action items:
  - Laura: prepare a 60-min technical demo runbook + sample dataset note (stub: Demo_Runbook.pdf).
  - Karthik: confirm AWS field alignment and whether we can add Solstice to the AWS co-sell intake now (need AWS rep name).
  - Legal/Sales Ops: prepare Marketplace vs PO comparison and a short contracting checklist (liability, SLA, data residency).
  - Irene: coordinate intro meeting slot and share MAP + intake form in advance.

- Risks / blockers to flag:
  - If Solstice requires on-prem data residency, that changes deployment options.
  - Procurement has called out liability and SLA priorities — expect redline requests.

Let me know if anything else to add. I'll draft an internal run-of-show for the 30-min intro so we can keep it tight and identify follow-ups for the technical deep dive.

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

--
Note: internal-only thread excerpt. Attachment stub: Demo_Runbook.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Solstice Health AWS co-sell — prep checklist (do not forward)

Thanks Kim — quick technical notes to include in the run-of-show and the 60-min follow-up: 

- Demo scope: 20-min high-level (team + product), 40-min lab: model inference latency/cost walk-through using a synthetic subset of Solstice sample records (PII removed).
- Pre-reqs: small S3 bucket with sample JSONL (we can provide instructions), list of target inference throughput (qps) and desired latency SLA.
- Security artifacts we can share during the intro: SOC 2 summary, encryption at rest/Transit note, and our KMS integration options. Full SOC 2 report will go via secure share after NDA.
- Recommended follow-up: a short engineering spike (2–3 days) to run the model on target infra; we'll scope in the test plan at the technical deep dive.

I attached the demo runbook draft and a checklist for PII sanitization. I'll refine after the intro.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment stubs: Demo_Runbook.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell: Solstice Health kickoff — stakeholder map, procurement windows, and demo cadence

Elliot / Nora — thanks for confirming. Per your windows, let's lock Wed 10/07 14:00–14:30 PT for the intro. Calendar invite to follow from my assistant.

Quick confirm: we'll cover roles and success criteria in the intro and surface the security artifacts Laura mentioned. Post-intro we'll run the 60-min technical deep dive (we propose Thu 10/08 11:00–12:00 PT) — Nora, if that timing clashes with procurement priorities let us know and we can shift.

Attached: Solstice_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (filled with initial milestones), RDW_AWS_CoSell_Intake_Form.pdf (filled), and a short link to the HubSpot deal for reference. Please review the MAP milestones for legal and procurement milestones so we can update before the technical deep dive.

On the Marketplace vs PO point — we'll prepare a one-page comparison for the intro so you can see tradeoffs (pricing visibility vs procurement cadence).

See you on Wednesday.

Best,
Irene
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
